docsCopy.title: Documentation
docsCopy.description: Connect the demo dataset through CSV or Google Sheets and check your MXMT reports.
docsCopy.trainingIntro: DEMO-2026-FULL-v3 is a synthetic fashion retail dataset for practising in MXMT. The full dataset contains 96 SKUs, 4,348 order events, 645 receipts and 36,192 stock observations. The exercise uses a September 2026 extract with 6 SKUs, 26 order lines and 180 stock observations.

importSteps.title: Open a separate workspace
importSteps.text: Create a training workspace or sign in to it as an administrator. Go to Settings → General → CSV import.

importSteps.title: Upload the three files
importSteps.text: Upload products.csv under Products, stock.csv under Dated stock and orders.csv under Order lines. Select comma as the delimiter for each file and check the column mapping against the headers. The productId must match across the three files.

importSteps.title: Set the import rules
importSteps.text: Use Europe/Kyiv and UAH. Set catalogue and stock to Complete source population. Map 5 → SALE and 7 → RETURN. Replace the default channel 1 with 38 → Online store, 68 → Marketplace, 78 → Kyiv showroom and 79 → Instagram. Choose unit price after discount, percentage discount and cost per unit.

importSteps.title: Set the history window
importSteps.text: For this separate training source, the file contains all September events in the extract. Confirm complete order history and enter 2026-08-31T21:00:00.000Z and 2026-09-30T20:59:59.999Z. Leave receipt history unchecked.

importSteps.title: Preview and activate the packet
importSteps.text: Confirm the rules and select Preview packet. Check for 6 products, 180 stock observations and 26 order lines with no errors. In Reporting source, select CSV and click Use for reports. Return to the packet, select Activate validated packet and wait for ACTIVE. If settings changed and the packet requires another review, select Preview packet again.

importSteps.title: Confirm the product type for all six SKUs
importSteps.text: Go to Settings → General → Data quality and search for DEMO-. Set Product type to Merchandise on all six rows to include them in sales totals. Gross profit also requires verified stock ownership.

importSteps.title: Check your reports
importSteps.text: Use the September report link below to set the sales period to 1–30 September 2026 and the stock date to 30 September. With all channels selected, check UAH 37,551 in revenue, 36 net units sold, one return and 93 units in stock. The extract lacks the history for year-over-year comparisons and metrics that require receipts.

docsCopy.annualIntro: Use a workspace where the full DEMO-2026-FULL-v3 is already active. The demo reports were calculated in an isolated environment with a reference date of 2 January 2027.
annualSteps: In Overview, select 1 January–31 December 2026 and all channels. Check revenue of UAH 8,617,801.50 and net sales of 2,901 units.
In Sales, review the breakdown by channel and product. In Inventory, check the closing stock of 3,623 units on 31 December 2026.

For the reordering exercise, select 27–30 November 2026 and find DEMO-007-S, DEMO-007-M and DEMO-007-L. This scenario confirms zero units in transit for these SKUs. Review the scenario before exporting.
docsCopy.annualNote: The annual JSON is used for the isolated annual run. The CSV form accepts up to 500 rows per packet, and live reports limit the selected period to the current date.
ownSteps: In Settings → General → CSV import, download the template for the resource you need. Submit products and dated stock as separate files in the same packet.

Save the files in UTF-8 with comma, semicolon or tab separators. Use a decimal point for amounts, YYYY-MM-DD or UTC ISO dates for events, and UTC ISO timestamps ending in Z for observations and updates. Preserve leading zeros in SKUs and other identifiers.
Verify the columns and business rules for your source. Confirm complete history only for a verified interval. If the preview reports an error, fix the indicated file and row and preview it again.
exportSteps: Prepare a scenario in Repricing or Reordering, review its totals and select the relevant rows. Export is available to users with the required permissions.
Download the CSV. It uses UTF-8 with a BOM and a semicolon separator. Reordering files are grouped by supplier and currency.
Check SKUs, prices or quantities, and currency before importing the file into another system. Apply store changes or place supplier orders separately.

sheetsCopy.title: Connect Google Sheets
sheetsCopy.intro: The demo workbook contains synthetic fashion retail data. The import uses Product YML 2.0 and ZAVOD_API. Use 1–29 October 2026 to check the reports.

steps.title: Connect the spreadsheet
steps.text: Sign in as an administrator in a separate training workspace. Under Settings → General → This cabinet’s Google Sheets, paste the demo spreadsheet link and select Save connection. For a restricted spreadsheet, its owner needs to give the MXMT service account read access.

steps.title: Import the source data
steps.text: Open Other tools → Data & Reports → Google Sheets. Confirm the spreadsheet under Next import and select Import. The first import saves the source tables. The main reports are prepared after the mapping is approved.

steps.title: Review and approve the mapping
steps.text: Return to Settings → General → Google Sheets · data mapping and choose the imported spreadsheet. Check the columns below and set the rules for currency, amounts, statuses, channels and product types. Preview the mapping, review errors and select Approve this revision.

steps.title: Select the source and refresh reports
steps.text: In Reporting source, select the approved Google Sheets connection and click Use for reports. Return to Data & Reports → Google Sheets and select Refresh MVP reports.

steps.title: Check the October snapshot
steps.text: Open the report for 1–29 October 2026 with stock dated 29 October and all channels selected. The workbook’s control totals are UAH 918,571 in revenue and 4,224 units in stock. For repricing and reordering, check that ownership, receipts and supplier terms are verified.
